definitions.explanation: Of a house or building: destroyed beyond repair, in an earthquake, fire, storm or accident. Also the top grade in the official assessment of disaster damage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{百棟|ひゃくとう}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全壊|ぜんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: More than a hundred buildings were destroyed in the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全壊|ぜんかい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、{仮設住宅|かせつじゅうたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Our home was judged a total loss, and we ended up living in temporary housing.

notes:
⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (whole) + {壊|かい} (break).

USAGE:
Disaster reports grade damage to houses as {全壊|ぜんかい} (total loss), {半壊|はんかい} (half destroyed) and {一部損壊|いちぶそんかい} (partly damaged); the grade decides what support a household receives.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{倒壊|とうかい}→倒壊：25308_toukai⟧: collapse; the building falls down
- ⟦{損壊|そんかい}→損壊：33186_sonkai⟧: damage of any degree

WATCH OUT:
Three other ぜんかい words: ⟦{全快|ぜんかい}→全快：16255_zenkai⟧ (full recovery), ⟦{全開|ぜんかい}→全開：29588_zenkai⟧ (fully open) and ⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧ (last time).
